name: st-status
title: Status
description: Set your status across Slack and GitHub with a single command, with reminders for Linear.
author: wassimk

preferences.name: slackToken
preferences.title: Slack Token
preferences.description: Slack User OAuth Token (xoxp-...) with users.profile:write and dnd:write scopes. Passed to st as SLACK_PAT.

preferences.name: githubToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token
preferences.description: GitHub classic Personal Access Token with user and read:org scopes. Passed to st as GITHUB_PAT.

commands.name: lunch
commands.title: Lunch
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Set a lunch status with DND, ending at the next quarter hour plus an hour or at a given time

commands.name: meeting
commands.title: Meeting
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Set an in a meeting status, optionally until a time

commands.name: pairing
commands.title: Pairing
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Set an in a pairing session status, optionally until a time

commands.name: eod
commands.title: End of Day
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Set an outside work hours status with DND until the next work day at 7am

commands.name: vacation
commands.title: Vacation
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Set an off recharging status with DND and mark GitHub busy

commands.name: sick
commands.title: Sick
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Set an out sick status with DND and mark GitHub busy

commands.name: away
commands.title: Away
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Set an away for a bit status with DND and mark GitHub busy, until 5pm by default

commands.name: back
commands.title: Back
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Clear DND and GitHub busy, and set a catching up status for 15 minutes

commands.name: clear
commands.title: Clear Status
commands.subtitle: st
commands.description: Clear Slack status, DND, and GitHub status

tools.name: set-status
tools.title: Set Status
tools.description: Set the user's status across Slack and GitHub using a keyword, an optional end date or time, and an optional custom message

ai.instructions: This extension sets the user's work status in Slack and GitHub with the st CLI. Pick the keyword that matches what the user is doing: lunch, meeting, pairing, eod (done for the day), vacation, sick, away (out for part of the day), back (returning), or clear. Work days are Monday through Thursday. Pass when the user says when they'll be back, using formats like 'friday', 'tomorrow', '3/10', '3/10 9am', or just a time like '2pm'. Only pass a message when the user asks for specific status text. After setting an out of office status, remind the user to add a Google Calendar out-of-office event so Linear shows them as away.
